prerequisites.name: screencapture
prerequisites.detail: macOS built-in; window-scoped stills and timed video

prerequisites.name: Screen Recording
prerequisites.detail: Granted to the host application that runs the pane, not to the pane itself; missing permission yields a black or empty capture

prerequisites.name: window selection
prerequisites.detail: A selected application window id; never the whole desktop by default

disallowed: Whole-desktop capture unless the manifest privacy capture_scope says desktop and the user asked for it
Changing permission grants or triggering a grant prompt during capture
Driving the application; journeys are manual steps or a separately declared driver
notes: Recording uses the -V seconds and window options; confirm the exact flags on the pilot host before documenting them as supported
Window id lookup is a read-only step performed before capture
